name: Heartwoven

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can help keep the perilous marsh routes around Menethil Harbor safe for the civilians who rely on them.
When Caitlin learns her partner survived, she sets out to prepare a warm, hearty meal to welcome him home.

faq.answer: A traveler helps Ardin Grassman after he becomes stranded at the Wetlands excavation sites. Ardin makes a reed heart to carry word of his survival and affection to Caitlin Grassman, who waits in Menethil Harbor.

Caitlin Grassman waits anxiously in Menethil Harbor for her husband, Ardin. She fears for his life after he went to the Wetlands excavation sites, and feels relief when you bring word that he survived.
The reed-woven heart is a token Ardin makes from marsh reeds in his pack. He sends it with you to reassure Caitlin that he is alive and returning home soon.
You bring the reed heart to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor, the Alliance port town on the western coast of the Wetlands.
faq.q: Where do you turn in Heartwoven?

faq.answer: Ardin Grassman gives you the heart to carry to Caitlin, his wife. After you clear a safe path through the Wetlands, he rests, gathers his bushels, and sends you ahead with the token.
faq.q: Who gives you the quest Heartwoven?

faq.answer: Ardin went to the excavation sites to see strange towering grasses, but agitated wildlife overwhelmed the excavation team, especially spiders. You clear a path through the surrounding threats, allowing Ardin to survive, gather his bushels, and head back to Menethil Harbor.
faq.q: What happened to the stranded gatherer?

sections.body: Ardin Grassman went to see the strange grasses at the Wetlands excavation sites, but became stranded among the marsh’s dangers. You clear a path through the wilderness, giving him room to rest and gather his harvest. Tired but determined, Ardin prepares to return toward the safety of the port.
sections.title: A Signal from the Marshes

sections.body: Before setting out for home, Ardin takes marsh reeds from his pack and braids them into a heart. He gives you the token to carry to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor. She has been waiting in worry. Word that Ardin survived and will soon return brings relief, along with the reed heart and the promise of a warm meal.
sections.title: Tokens of Menethil

summary: In the Wetlands, Ardin Grassman has survived the marsh’s dangers and sends word to Menethil Harbor. A traveler carries a reed heart to Caitlin Grassman.
